name: zsh-fanout
description: Install zsh + Oh-My-Zsh + curated .zshrc on every host in the target group by uploading the 60/61/62 bundle and running scripts-linux/60-install-zsh/run.sh remotely. Honours TARGET_USER so root can provision for any user.

inputs.ZSH_BUNDLE_B64: Required. base64 -w0 of a tar.gz of scripts-linux/{_shared,60-install-zsh,61-install-zsh-theme-switcher,62-install-zsh-clear}.
inputs.REMOTE_BUNDLE_DIR: Where the bundle is unpacked on each remote (default: /opt/zsh-fanout)
inputs.TARGET_USER: Optional. When set, run '60 install --user <name>' (drops privileges to that user).
inputs.DRY_RUN: 1 = print the remote commands without executing the installs.
